translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: Romanos
book.title: Romagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Garda Narmaksad Romanos

content: Bab Dummad Abraham iskussuliyob daksad
¿Degite, igi an sogmalosunna, anmar-dad-Abraham, igi gusa dule-iskussulidyob-dakleged-igargi?
Ar Abraham na e-ibmar-imaksadba iskussuliyob daklenonikina, sunna dulemar-asabin na san dummarba na itogoendo, Bab-Dummad-asabindi geg na san dummarba imakenad.
Emigindi, ¿igi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaisunna?
Ar dule arbasale, binsa nabir-dakedba bennuklesulid, arbasad-ular bennukleged.
Ar dule-ibmar-imaksasuliddi, ar bensulir, Bab Dummadde sunna iskussulidyob dule-imakye. Bab Dummad we-dule e-bensulidba, iskussulidyob daknoni-dasunnad.
Ar amba deyob David sogmogad, Bab Dummad iskussulidyob dule-daknonikile, we-dule na e-ibmar-imaksadbarsurye. Bab Dummad we-dulegi nued binsasye.
David Bab-Dummad-Gardagi soged:

content.text: We-dulegi nued binsalesdo, Bab Dummad ega soger,

content: Degisoggu, we dulegi-nued-binsaleged ¿unnila Judiomargarbi, igi, Judiosurmaladgarmoga? Ar ade an sogmalad, Abraham Bab-Dummad-bensulidbali iskussulidyob Bab Dummad we-Abraham-daknoniye.
Degite, ¿sana wede deyob Abrahamga gusa? ¿Abgan-duku-siked-iduale, igi, abgan-duku-siksad-sorbali? Abgan-duku-siksad-sorbar-sulid, amba yo abgan-duku-siked-iduale, we deyob ega gusad.

Geb sorba Abraham abgan-duku-siked-igar imaksad, adi oyogegar, amba yo abgan-duku sike, Bab Dummad, Abraham-iskussulidyob daksad. Abraham Bab-Dummad-bengussulidba, a-e-wilub-nasikegala, abgan-duku-siked-igar imaksad. Degisoggu, a-ulale, bela dulemar-abgan-duku-sikarsurmalad-Bab-Dummadgi-bensurmalad, amar-e-babga Abraham gunonisunnad, adi amar Bab-Dummadgi-bensulidba iskussulidyob daklemogagar.

Degine, Abraham dulemar-abgan-duku-sikarmalad e-babga gunonibalid. We-dulemar, unnila abgan-dukubi-sikarsurmalad, anmar-dad-Abraham amba yo abgan-duku-siked-idu Bab-Dummadgi-bensuli nanadigusadyob nanadimarmogad.
Bab Dummad Abrahamga-ibmar-nuegan-ukoye-sogsad
Bab Dummad Abrahamga, degi, e-waganga sogsad, yoedse we-napneg-naid an bega ukoye. We-Moisés-igar-maidba ega sogsasulid, Bab-Dummadgi-bensulidba iskussuliyob-daklenoni-daed-igarba ega sogsad.

We-ibmar-yoedse-abingaoye-sogsad Moisés-igar-maidba-nanadiid-ular ibmar abingalegena, Bab-Dummadgi-bensulid-igar binsaledga gunonikindo, degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-ukoye-sogsad binsaledga gunonibalindo.
Ar igar-maidba dule dasulile, igar-maid-ular a-dule sabsur odurdakleged. Ar igar maisulirdi, dule igargi geg annaed, ar igar sulid.

Degisoggu, a-ulale Bab Dummad Abrahamga sogsad, an bega ibmar-nuegan ukoye. A-ibmar Bab-Dummadgi-bensulid-igarba abingaleged, dule ibmar-imaksadginsulid, Bab Dummad deyob imaksad, adi na e-ibmar-nuegan-ukbiedba Abraham-waganga ukmogagar, unnila dulemar Moisés-igar-mesisadba Abraham-waganga gudimaladgarbisulid, dulemar-belagwapa Bab-Dummadgi-Abraham-bengussulidyob-nanadimarmogadga a-ibmar ukmogagalad. Ar Abraham bela anmar-dadga gunonisunnad.
Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naidyob:

Gn. 17:5 Abraham Bab-Dummad-asabin anmar-dadad. Bab Dummad dulemar-burgwismalad gannar oduloged, degine, ibmar-amba-yo-ambikued e-nugba ese goled bato ibmar ambikusadyob. We-Bab-Dummadgi Abraham bengussulid.
Gwen ega igarga gued Abraham daksasur-inigwele, Abraham nue-bensulidgi Bab-Dummad-ega-sogsad edarbedii-gusad, dulemar-bukidarad-akar-akar-bukmalad e-dad-sailaga gued, ar igi Bab Dummad ega sogsadyob:

Abraham na e-sangi binsadgu, deun bato birga-dulatar-gubin nikad, bato burgwed omosad, degite, Bab-Dummadgi-bensulid gwen galakussulid, degine, e-ome-Saragi binsadbargu, bato mimmi-baked-e-ibagan bergussoggu, we guosurdeeye gwen binsassurbalid.
Degine, Abraham ibmar-ega-uklegoye-soglesad, ega guosur dakle-inigwele, degite, gwen bengussulid, aka-bur-bule Bab-Dummad-bengusulidgi gannaledii-gusad, Bab-Dummad-nug-ogannodii-nanasad,
Abraham nue wisi-gusad, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-ukoye-sogsad na e-ganguedba bela e-sogsadba ibmar imaked.
Degisoggu,
Abraham Bab-Dummadgi-bensulidba Bab Dummad Abraham iskussuliyob daknoniye sogedi, unnila Abrahamgarbi narmaklessulid.
Amarga narmaklesmogad, anmar Bab-Dummadgi-bensurmarmogad-ular, Bab Dummad iskussuliyob anmar-daknoni-damarmogadga. We-Bab-Dummadde, anmar-Dummad-Jesús burgwar-maigu gannar odulosad.
We-Jesús, anmar-iskued-ular oburgwilegegala uklesad, degine, gannar durgus gusad, adi anmar iskussuliyob daklegegar.
